package.description: A Windows desktop organizer with a quick launcher, clipboard history, and global search.

en-US.description: A Windows desktop organizer with a quick launcher, clipboard history, and global search.
en-US.longDescription:
DustDesk is a Tauri 2 based Windows desktop efficiency tool that keeps your desktop tidy.
It organizes desktop files into category boxes with drag in, drag out, and move-back support, launches programs and files in batch, keeps text and image clipboard history behind Ctrl+Tab, and offers Ctrl+Space global search with history. It runs minimized to the system tray, and the data, organizer, and launcher directories are configurable.
en-US.name: DustDesk

zh-CN.description: 集快速启动、剪贴板历史与全局搜索于一体的 Windows 桌面整理工具。
zh-CN.longDescription:
DustDesk 是一款基于 Tauri 2 的 Windows 桌面效率工具，让桌面保持整洁。
它将桌面文件收纳进分类盒子，支持拖入、拖出和移回原位，可以批量启动程序和文件，通过 Ctrl+Tab 保留文本和图片剪贴板历史，并提供 Ctrl+Space 全局搜索与历史记录。它可以最小化到系统托盘运行，数据、收纳和启动目录均可自定义。
